config.slimeform.title: Slime Form Settings
config.slimeform.max_slime_size.tooltip: The largest slime size the player can reach. Values range from 1 to 10.
config.slimeform.slime_balls_required.to: The number of slime balls required for one size increase.
config.slimeform.rider_offset_x.tooltip: Adjust the player's horizontal X position for each size above size 1. Enter a value from -1.0 to 1.0.
config.slimeform.rider_offset_y.tooltip: Adjust the player's vertical position for each size above size 1. Enter a value from -1.0 to 1.0.
config.slimeform.rider_offset_z.tooltip: Adjust the player's horizontal Z position for each size above size 1. Enter a value from -1.0 to 1.0.
Show copied main-hand and off-hand items inside sleeping and dormant slimes.
config.slimeform.split_duration.tooltip: How long a split slime recovery lasts before the player reforms.
config.slimeform.recovery_flee_path_debu: Show the active recovery slime flee path and nearby hostile markers with particles.
config.slimeform.recovery_flee_danger_de: Show a bossbar for the nearest hostile mob within the recovery flee radius.
Show each recovery slime's shared lineage identifier and generation above it.
config.slimeform.recovery_reform_safety_: Distance from hostile mobs that prevents size-1 recovery reforming.
config.slimeform.recovery_hostile_reform: Prevent size-1 recovery reforming while hostile mobs are within the safety radius.
config.slimeform.passive_spawning.toolti: Allow slime-form players to attract occasional nearby slimes.
config.slimeform.spawn_chance.tooltip: The chance used for each passive spawning attempt.
config.slimeform.spawn_cooldown.tooltip: Minimum time between passive spawning attempts.
config.slimeform.max_nearby_slimes.toolt: Maximum number of slimes attracted by this mechanic near a player.
config.slimeform.afk_enabled.tooltip: Transform inactive SlimeForm players into a protected dormant slime.
config.slimeform.afk_debug.tooltip: Show the server-authoritative countdown to dormant mode above the hotbar.
config.slimeform.afk_duration.tooltip: How long a SlimeForm player must remain inactive before becoming dormant. Dangerous or combat situations prevent activation.
config.slimeform.water_behavior.tooltip: Make slime-form players sink slightly slower without preventing drowning.
config.slimeform.item_main_hand_offset_x: Adjust the main-hand item display's X position.
config.slimeform.item_main_hand_offset_y: Adjust the main-hand item display's Y position.
config.slimeform.item_main_hand_offset_z: Adjust the main-hand item display's Z position.
Adjust the off-hand item display's X position.
Adjust the off-hand item display's Y position.
Adjust the off-hand item display's Z position.
config.slimeform.item_display_scale.tool: Adjust the scale of floating item displays.
config.slimeform.item_display_rotation_x: Adjust the item display's X rotation in degrees.
config.slimeform.item_display_rotation_y: Adjust the item display's Y rotation in degrees.
config.slimeform.item_display_rotation_z: Adjust the item display's Z rotation in degrees.
config.slimeform.item_display_bob_amplit: Adjust how much floating item displays bob up and down.
config.slimeform.item_debug_show_axes.to: Show debug particles marking item display axes.

config.slimeform.experimental.disabled: Experimental features are disabled. Enable them only if you accept the risks.
config.slimeform.experimental.available: No experimental features are available yet.
config.slimeform.experimental.confirm.me: Experimental features is still early in development and may include game breaking or unfair gameplay.
config.slimeform.experimental.placeholde: No experimental features are available yet.
